title: Stripe wants to own the toll booth between AI models, for ~$10bn
excerpt: Stripe wants a foothold in AI, and it is willing to pay dearly for it. The payments company is in talks to buy OpenRouter for about $10 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported. content_html:
Stripe wants a foothold in AI, and it is willing to pay dearly for it. The payments company is in talks to buy OpenRouter for about $10 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported. That is a staggering price for a startup valued at just $1.3 billion in May. The talks are preliminary, and could still fall apart or draw a rival bidder.

OpenRouter is a marketplace for AI models. Founded in New York in 2023, it lets developers reach more than 400 large language models from around 70 providers through one interface. It routes each request to the cheapest or best option. Its co-founder Alex Atallah, who previously built the NFT marketplace OpenSea, calls it “an AI equivalent of Stripe”!

That pitch is the whole story. As AI bills climb, companies want to spread their work across many models rather than lock in with one lab. OpenRouter sits in the middle. It is the toll booth between the labs that build the models and the businesses that use them. Those can be open models, or closed ones from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Stripe, valued at $159 billion, wants to own that toll booth as it pushes beyond payments into AI infrastructure. The two already work together, as OpenRouter uses Stripe to bill its own customers.

Stripe’s second big swing

This is not Stripe’s only large bet in play. It is separately chasing PayPal with the private-equity firm Advent. That unsolicited offer valued PayPal at roughly $53 billion, and PayPal rebuffed it as too low. Nor is Stripe the only suitor for OpenRouter. Databricks held early talks too, The Information reported, and the Journal says other big tech firms circled.

Is a router worth $10bn?

The price has raised eyebrows. OpenRouter has doubled its value in a year. It would now fetch nearly eight times its May figure, at a moment when AI deals are running hot. Sceptics question whether a model router has durable value. If AI tokens become cheap and plentiful, the argument goes, why pay to route between them?

On Hacker News, one commenter noted the software itself would be cheap to rebuild. The value, they argued, is the existing customers and the switching costs. Once a company’s logs and budgets sit in one place, moving is painful. The investor Alex Konrad sees a coming clash. “The AI showdown nobody is talking about yet is Ramp vs. Stripe,” he wrote.

For Stripe, the logic is defensive as much as offensive. Whoever controls how companies buy and route AI controls a fast-growing slice of their spending. Stripe would rather own it than watch a rival take it. The catch is that this is still talks, not a deal. A transaction could come within a month, the reports say, or not at all.

content_html_zh:
Stripe 希望在人工智能领域立足，并且愿意为此付出高昂的代价。 据《华尔街日报》报道，该支付公司正在洽谈以约 100 亿美元收购 OpenRouter。 对于一家 5 月份估值仅为 13 亿美元的初创公司来说，这是一个惊人的价格。 谈判是初步的，仍可能破裂或吸引竞争对手竞购。

OpenRouter 是人工智能模型的市场。 它于 2023 年在纽约成立，让开发人员可以通过一个界面访问来自约 70 个提供商的 400 多种大型语言模型。 它将每个请求路由到最便宜或最好的选项。 其联合创始人 Alex Atallah 曾创建过 NFT 市场 OpenSea，他称其为“Stripe 的人工智能版本”！

这个音调就是整个故事。 随着人工智能费用的攀升，公司希望将他们的工作分散到多种模型上，而不是局限于一个实验室。 OpenRouter 位于中间。 它是构建模型的实验室和使用模型的企业之间的收费站。 这些可以是开放模型，也可以是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的封闭模型。

Stripe 估值 1590 亿美元，希望拥有该收费站，因为它将超越支付领域，进入人工智能基础设施领域。 两者已经合作，因为 OpenRouter 使用 Stripe 向自己的客户计费。

Stripe 的第二次大转变

这并不是 Stripe 唯一的大赌注。 它正在与私募股权公司 Advent 分别追逐 PayPal。 这项主动提出的报价对 PayPal 的估值约为 530 亿美元，但 PayPal 认为估值太低而拒绝了。 Stripe 并不是 OpenRouter 的唯一追求者。 据《The Information》报道，Databricks 也举行了早期会​​谈，《华尔街日报》称其他大型科技公司也参与了会谈。

一个路由器值100亿美元吗？

价格引起了人们的关注。 OpenRouter 的价值在一年内翻了一番。 现在，在人工智能交易火爆之际，它的价格将是 5 月份价格的近八倍。 怀疑论者质疑模型路由器是否具有持久价值。 有人认为，如果人工智能代币变得便宜且充足，为什么还要花钱在它们之间进行路由呢？

在《黑客新闻》上，一位评论者指出，该软件本身的重建成本很低。 他们认为，价值在于现有客户和转换成本。 一旦公司的日志和预算集中在一个地方，移动就会很痛苦。 投资者亚历克斯·康拉德（Alex Konrad）预见到一场即将到来的冲突。 “目前还没有人谈论的人工智能对决是 Ramp 与 Stripe，”他写道。

对于 Stripe 来说，其逻辑既是进攻性的，也是防御性的。 谁控制了公司如何购买和传播人工智能，谁就控制了其支出中快速增长的部分。 Stripe 宁愿拥有它，也不愿看着竞争对手夺走它。 问题是这仍然是谈判，而不是达成协议。 报道称，交易可能会在一个月内完成，也可能根本不会完成。
